In [[470 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] '''attempted to secede''' from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to become an independent system. The leaders of the independence movement went as far as invoking ''[[Contemplanys Hermi]]'', which withdrew its membership from the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. Ultimately, the attempt failed and Corellia rejoined the Republic.
